title: The join-rules page cannot send meetingUrl/sessionKey: its opt-out UI only knows a typed event id, so W7 gate (b) / ISS-T037OPT-002 cannot be met from the join-rules page alone
evidence: Opt-out input is a free-text 'Event id to opt out of'; GET /calendar/join-rules returns state.optedOutEventIds (strings) and no event list, no meetingUrl, no sessionKey. The page therefore has no source for the hints and (correctly) sends { eventId } only. The client plumbing exists (postPending/optOutBody accept hints, send them only when non-empty, tested) but nothing supplies them. The web Calendar page does hold meetingUrl per event (calendar-model.ts, AgendaView.tsx) but has no opt-out control; sessionKey is not in any web type.
fix_direction: Either (1) a calendar-side 'Do not join this meeting' action that calls postPending with the event's id and meetingUrl (apps/web only; sessionKey still needs a source), or (2) the calendar API response carries sessionKey/meetingUrl for each event and the opt-out picks from that list instead of free text. Until one lands W7 (b) stays open; the Approver may instead accept the id-only gap in writing (W7 last sentence).
note: meetingUrl half verified 118607b4; sessionKey web source outstanding

title: The 60 s Retry-After cap and the RetryButton timer cleanup are not pinned by any test; the busy code literal join_rules_busy is duplicated api/web with no cross-package pin
evidence: Checker mutations on 197f1c0, each survived all 65 join-rules tests: (1) Math.min(p.retryAfterSeconds ?? 0, MAX_RETRY_WAIT_SECONDS) -> (p.retryAfterSeconds ?? 0); (2) return () => clearTimeout(t) -> return; (3) parseRetryAfter regex {1,6} -> {1,12}. A scratch test (not committed) showed the shipped behaviour is correct: Retry-After 999999 leaves Retry disabled at 59 s and enabled by 60.5 s, no timer left after unmount. So this is an unpinned stated guarantee, not a live defect.
fix_direction: Add a fake-timer test: Retry-After 999999 -> Retry disabled at 59 s, enabled at 61 s; and one that unmounts during the wait and asserts vi.getTimerCount() === 0. The api-side pin of the code literal and of Retry-After 5 (ISS-JRLOCK-002 b) belongs to an apps/api unit. Verify inside the next unit touching JoinRulesPage.tsx.
